import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem complementary_pascal_sum_eq_n_iff (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
  Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = n ↔ k = 1 ∨ k = n - 1 := by
  have hpascal :
      Nat.choose n k =
        Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) + Nat.choose (n - 1) k := by
    have hn' : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
    have hk' : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    calc
      Nat.choose n k =
          Nat.choose (n - 1 + 1) (k - 1 + 1) := by rw [hn', hk']
      _ = Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) +
          Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1 + 1) := by
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
          Nat.choose_succ_succ (n - 1) (k - 1)
      _ = Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) + Nat.choose (n - 1) k := by
        rw [hk']
  
  have hcollapse :
      Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) =
        Nat.choose n k := by
    rw [Nat.add_comm, hpascal]
  
  have hbig :
      ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ m - 2 →
        m < Nat.choose m j := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        intro hm
        omega
    | succ m ih =>
        intro hm j hj hjm
        by_cases hm3 : m = 3
        · subst m
          have hj' : j = 2 := by omega

            have hprev := ih hm2 (j - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
            have hpos : 0 < Nat.choose m j := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)

    by_cases hkn' : k = n

  Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) = n ↔ k = 1 ∨ k = n - 1 := by
  have haux : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ m - 1 →
      m ≤ Nat.choose m j ∧
        (Nat.choose m j = m ↔ j = 1 ∨ j = m - 1) := by
    intro m hm
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        omega
    | succ m ih =>
        by_cases hm1 : m = 1
        · subst m
          intro j hj hjm
          interval_cases j <;> simp
        · have hm' : 2 ≤ m := by omega
          intro j hj hjm
          by_cases hj1 : j = 1
          · subst j
            simp [Nat.choose_one_right]
          · by_cases hjlast : j = m
            · subst j
              simp [Nat.choose_succ_self_right]
            · have hjm' : j ≤ m - 1 := by omega
              have hjpred : 1 ≤ j - 1 := by omega
              have hpred : j - 1 ≤ m - 1 := by omega
              have h₁ := ih hm' (j - 1) hjpred hpred
              have h₂ := ih hm' j (by omega) hjm'
              rw [Nat.choose_succ_left m j (by omega : 0 < j)]
              constructor
              · omega
              · constructor <;> omega
  
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc : Nat.choose n k = n := by
      rw [Nat.choose_eq_choose_pred_add (by omega : 0 < n) hk]
      simpa [Nat.add_comm] using h
    by_cases hkn' : k = n
    · subst k
      simp [Nat.choose_self] at hc
      omega
    · have hkle : k ≤ n - 1 := by omega
      exact (haux n hn k hk hkle).2.mp hc
  · intro h
    have hkle : k ≤ n - 1 := by
      rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> omega
    have hc := (haux n hn k hk hkle).2.mpr h
    calc
      Nat.choose (n - 1) k + Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) =
          Nat.choose (n - 1) (k - 1) + Nat.choose (n - 1) k := Nat.add_comm _ _
      _ = Nat.choose n k :=
        (Nat.choose_eq_choose_pred_add (by omega : 0 < n) hk).symm
